# JetLearn

> > JetLearn offers live online coding, AI, and robotics classes for kids aged 6-16, teaching Python, Scratch, Minecraft, Roblox, and web development through expert-led instruction.

JetLearn provides personalized STEM education with daily live workshops, summer camps, and GCSE Computer Science exam preparation. The platform emphasizes hands-on learning and growth mindset development through project-based coding curricula.

## Key Topics

- Coding for Kids
- Python Programming
- Scratch Programming
- Minecraft & Tynker
- Roblox Development
- HTML & Web Development
- JavaScript Projects
- Math Anxiety & Dyscalculia
- Hands-on Learning
- Growth Mindset
- STEM Education
- Online Learning
- Beginner Coding
- Educational Activities
- Parent Guides

## Core Programs & Courses

- [School Summer Camp 2025](https://www.jetlearn.com/school-summer-camp-2025): AI-focused summer camp 2025 with Python, Scratch, and Roblox for kids
- [Minecraft with Tynker](https://www.jetlearn.com/courses/minecraft-with-tynker): Minecraft coding course with Tynker and Scratch for kids
- [GCSE Computer Science Prep](https://www.jetlearn.com/gcse): GCSE Computer Science exam prep with Python tutoring for UK students
- [JetLearn Events](https://www.jetlearn.com/jetlearn-events): Daily live coding workshops with Roblox, Minecraft, Python & AI for kids
- [Pricing & Curriculum Levels](https://www.jetlearn.com/ecommerce-page-two): JetLearn pricing & curriculum levels for coding, AI, and robotics classes

## Coding & Web Development Projects

- [JavaScript Projects for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/10-fun-and-easy-javascript-projects-for-kids): 10 beginner JavaScript projects for kids aged 8-16 using Scratch & Blockly
- [Fun HTML Learning for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/10-ways-to-make-html-learning-fun-for-kids): 10 creative ways to teach HTML to kids ages 6-16 using Tynker & CodeCombat
- [HTML Facts for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/15-fun-html-facts-for-kids-that-make-coding-cool): 15 fun HTML facts and web development basics for beginner coders
- [Coding Scholarships for Teens](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/10k-coding-scholarships-teens-are-missing-apply-now): Guide to $10K+ coding scholarships and grants for teen programmers

## Math Learning & Activities

- [Fun Math Experiments for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/30-fun-math-experiments-for-kids-ages-6-16): 30 hands-on STEM math experiments for ages 6-16 to build confidence
- [Math Trivia Questions for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/75-math-trivia-questions-and-answers-for-kids-build-confidence): 75+ age-appropriate math trivia questions for kids ages 6-16
- [Math Games for Dyscalculia Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/10-math-games-for-dyscalculia-kids-parent-favorites): Game-based learning activities for kids with dyscalculia
- [Best Mental Math Videos for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/25-best-mental-math-videos-for-kids-2025-free-safe): 25 curated mental math videos from Khan Academy, Math Antics & NUMBEROCK
- [DIY Math Toys for Kids](https://www.jetlearn.com/blog/10-diy-math-toys-for-kids-easy-wins-myths-busted): DIY math toys guide for ages 6-16 with hands-on LEGO-based projects

## Parent Resources & Guides
